comment: The EOA, EOD, EOS and EOR jacks are named for the end of each stage and the maker's tooltips call them the attack, decay, sustain and release period. The code holds each one at 10V and drops it to 0V during its own stage, so the useful edge is the rise at the end of the stage; the lines follow the code.
